Maya (Sales): Handing off Aperture Health account to CS. Closed yesterday — Dedicated + Private VPC, contract starts 2026-06-01. Pilot goal: 2026-06-21.

Maya (Sales): Context: they require Okta SSO, strict model pinning for audit, and token redaction for PHI. Finance flagged a possible budget review at 3 months (renewal risk).

Maya (Sales): Contacts: Priya (Lead PM) priya@aperturehealth.com, Marco (Infra). They need admin training + API integration docs during pilot.

Jai (CS): Taking onboarding lead. I'll schedule kickoff for 2026-06-03. Priya: can you share Okta SP metadata + sample users? Also list demo apps you want in the pilot.

Rina (Support): Support owning runbook & oncall. Need log retention window, SLOs, alert emails, and confirmation on token-trace redaction (we recommend redaction).

Dev (Eng): For private node + model pinning: confirm model name/version and whether quantization is allowed. If KMS/HSM involved, please provide key ARN. Post-kickoff I'll open infra ticket (triage ETA 4-6 business days).

Maya (Sales): Model: `aperture/clinical-encoder-3b` pinned to v3.0. They prefer FP16 (no quantization) to preserve accuracy. KMS = customer-managed cloud KMS; Priya will share ARN.

Jai (CS): Pilot success metrics: 1) p95 latency <200ms 2) 99% availability during demo window 3) PHI redaction validated. I'll collect sample prompts for PHI validation.

Rina (Support): I'll draft runbook checklist: Okta metadata, cert thumbprint, firewall IPs, logging policy, redaction settings, alerting channels, escalation contacts, and rollback steps. Draft by Mon 2026-06-01.

Dev (Eng): Draft infra ticket I'll open: `infra create --component=private-deploy --customer=Aperture --due=2026-06-10 --desc="VPC + model pinning + KMS scoping"`. Will attach perf baseline after staging tests.

Maya (Sales): Heads-up: finance wants a 3-month review checkpoint — tagging renewal risk. CS please capture ROI/use-case bullets in the kickoff doc to help justify continued spend.

Jai (CS): Will include ROI bullets and a feedback capture plan (post-demo survey + short interviews). Assigning feedback capture to me and Rina.

Rina (Support): Proposed feedback collection: short 3-question form + a scheduled 30-min interview after week 1 of pilot. I'll build the form template.

Dev (Eng): Note: refusing quantization raises cost; include cost delta in one-pager. I'll provide perf numbers from staging.

Maya (Sales): I'll hand over billing contact and procurement timeline in the kickoff doc.

ops-bot: Task created -> "aperture-private-scoping" assigned to Dev,Rina; due 2026-06-10.

Jai (CS): Action list: 1) Kickoff invite 2) Okta + KMS + infra contact 3) Runbook draft 4) Pilot success criteria + ROI doc 5) Feedback collection plan. I'll post kickoff doc here by EOD Fri.

Maya (Sales): Thanks — tag me for any contract or procurement holds.

Rina (Support): Will share runbook draft and survey template by Mon.

Dev (Eng): I'll post the infra ticket link after kickoff triage.

Jai (CS): Closing: will update this thread with invite + shared doc. :white_check_mark:
